scope: For affinity purification, HEK 293T cells stably expressing SFB-tagged protein from a total of 20 10-cm dishes were collected and lysed in NETN buffer
supernatants were incubated with 200 μl of streptavidin-Sepharose beads (Sigma-Aldrich; Cat#GE17-5113-01) overnight at 4 °C
The eluates were incubated with 40 μl of S-protein-agarose beads (Millipore; Cat#69704) for 2 h at 4 °C

The proteins bound to beads were eluted by boiling with 4X Laemmli buffer (SDS sample buffer), resolved by SDS-PAGE, and visualized by Coomassie Blue staining. Excised gel bands were cut into approximately 1 mm3 pieces.
